Subgroup Search for Treatment Effect Heterogeneity (Improved, Parallelized)

Source: R/subgroup_search.R
subgroup.search.Rd

Searches for subgroups with treatment effect heterogeneity using combinations of candidate factors. Evaluates subgroups for minimum prevalence, event counts, and hazard ratio threshold. Parallelizes the main search loop.

Usage

subgroup.search(
  Y,
  Event,
  Treat,
  ID = NULL,
  Z,
  n.min = 30,
  d0.min = 15,
  d1.min = 15,
  hr.threshold = 1,
  max.minutes = 30,
  minp = 0.05,
  rmin = 5,
  details = FALSE,
  maxk = 2,
  parallel_workers = parallel::detectCores(),
  estimator_fn = NULL,
  df_analysis = NULL,
  effect_threshold = NULL,
  effect_measure = NULL,
  outcome_type = NULL,
  adjust_covariates = NULL,
  disable_effect_floor = FALSE
)

Arguments

Y

Numeric vector of outcome (e.g., time-to-event).

Event

Numeric vector of event indicators (0/1).

Treat

Numeric vector of treatment group indicators (0/1).

ID

Optional vector of subject IDs.

Z

Matrix or data frame of candidate subgroup factors (binary indicators).

n.min

Integer. Minimum subgroup size.

d0.min

Integer. Minimum per-arm filter. For survival and binary outcomes: minimum number of events in the control arm within the candidate subgroup. Ignored for continuous outcomes (only n.min applies).

d1.min

Integer. Same as d0.min for the treatment arm.

hr.threshold

Numeric. c1, the screening threshold on a candidate subgroup's own effect: a candidate is retained only if its fitted effect exceeds this value. The scale is the one the caller compares on, and it differs by path. On the survival path effect_threshold is NULL, so this value reaches the comparison unchanged and is compared against the fitted hazard ratio on the natural scale (fit_cox_for_subgroup() returns exp(coef)): 1.25 means HR >= 1.25, not log(1.25). On the GLM paths the value arrives already on the comparison scale that forestsearch() resolved from the effect measure – link scale for the ratio measures (OR, RR, IRR), identity for RD, IRD and MD – and is compared against the estimator's estimate on that same scale. This is forestsearch()'s effect.threshold / hr.threshold. It is not the per-split threshold (c2, hr.consistency) and not the consistency rate (p*, pconsistency.threshold); neither is applied here – this function performs the screening stage only.

max.minutes

Deprecated (0.4.0.9000): accepted and ignored. It was documented as a wall-clock budget for the combination search but was never enforced in the parallel search path. Passing it emits one warning. Search scope is governed by maxk and the candidate-factor controls. The formal will be removed in a later release; drop it from calls.

minp

Numeric. Minimum prevalence rate for each factor.

rmin

Integer. Minimum required reduction in sample size when adding a factor.

details

Logical. Print details during execution.

maxk

Integer. Maximum number of factors in a subgroup.

parallel_workers

Integer. Number of parallel workers (default: all available cores).

estimator_fn

Closure or NULL. Effect-estimator closure from make_effect_estimator for GLM outcomes. Default NULL (uses Cox model).

df_analysis

Data frame or NULL. Full analysis dataset, passed to the GLM estimator for within-subgroup evaluation.

effect_threshold

Numeric or NULL. GLM effect threshold for subgroup selection. Default NULL (uses hr.threshold).

effect_measure

Character or NULL. Effect measure name (e.g., "OR", "HR", "RD"). Used for display labels in the filtering summary. Default NULL.

outcome_type

Character or NULL. One of "survival", "binary", "continuous", "count". Controls d0.min/d1.min interpretation: events per arm for binary/survival, ignored for continuous. Default NULL (inferred from estimator_fn presence).

adjust_covariates

This option is implemented but has not been tested against the manuscript analyses or the simulation studies of León and Anderson (2026a, 2026b), which use the unadjusted treatment-only fits. Character vector or NULL. Additional Cox model terms (e.g. "strata(x1)" or "x2") used to adjust the candidate-search Cox scorer on the survival path. Referenced columns are sourced from df_analysis. Ignored on the GLM path. Default NULL (treatment-only).

disable_effect_floor

Logical. When TRUE, the Status-6 effect threshold (hr.threshold) is not applied, so the full estimable candidate family is retained regardless of effect size. Set by forestsearch when sg_focus = "maxeff" so the effect maximiser ranges over an unconditional family. Default FALSE.

Value

List with found subgroups, maximum HR, search time, configuration info, and filtering statistics.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(survival)
df <- survival::gbsg
df$grade3 <- as.integer(df$grade == "3")
Z <- df[, c("age", "meno", "size", "grade3", "nodes", "pgr", "er")]
res <- subgroup.search(Y = df$rfstime, Event = df$status,
                       Treat = df$hormon, Z = Z,
                       hr.threshold = 1.25)
} # }
